title: East Kelowna Wine Route Tour Scenic Tastings and Local Wineries
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the heart of Kelowna’s wine country on the East Kelowna Wine Route tour. This immersive experience takes you through picturesque vineyards and boutique wineries known for their award-winning wines. Enjoy a relaxed day filled with wine tastings, expert guidance, and stunning views of Okanagan Lake and rolling hills. The tour includes visits to family-run wineries and the unique Vibrant Vine Winery and 3D Art Gallery. Customization options are available to make your tour truly special, with convenient transportation from your location included.

- Explore 4 amazing winery stops, including the Vibrant Vine Winery
- Choose between half-day and full-day tour options
- All-inclusive with wine tasting fees and complimentary snacks
- Expert local guide ensures a personal and engaging experience
